title: WEAVER, Better, Faster, Longer: An Effective World Model for Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: WEAVER：更好、更快、更长的机器人操作世界模型
abstract: The potential impacts of world models (WMs, i.e., learned simulators) on robotics are far-reaching -- policy evaluation, policy improvement, and test-time planning -- all with limited real-world interaction. To unlock these downstream capabilities, a WM needs to jointly satisfy three desiderata: $\textit{(i)}$ fidelity (i.e., producing simulated trajectories that correlate with reality), $\textit{(ii)}$ consistency (i.e., producing simulated trajectories that are coherent over long horizons), an

editorial.selection_reason: 首个同时在fidelity、consistency、efficiency三个维度超越现有方法的机器人操作世界模型。核心贡献：(1)融合flow matching+扩散强制+KV缓存+rectified flow蒸馏实现5-10×速度提升；(2)内置潜在奖励模型和critic消除对外部VLM评判器的依赖；(3)统一支持policy evaluation(ρ=0.870相关性)、improvement(+38%成功率)、planning(+14%成功率)三个下游应用；(4)代码/模型全面开源。相较于看板中已有的WorldGym等世界模型，WEAVER首次实现了真实机器人上的端到端evaluation-improvement-planning闭环。主要风险：依赖π0.5作为基策略，新基策略需要重新训练WM；仅验证Franka单臂任务。
